name: Regularized Fitness
description:
A loss function that combines the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Standard Deviation (STD) of a list of values with respect to a target value. 
MAE evaluates the Accuracy to the target, while STD evaluates the Consistency of the values. 
The lower the fitness score, the better the fitness.

inputParameters.name: values
inputParameters.description: A list of numerical values to evaluate.

inputParameters.name: target
inputParameters.description: The target value to compare against.

inputParameters.name: k
inputParameters.description: A regularization parameter that controls the weight of the STD in the loss function.

outputParameters.name: fitness
outputParameters.description: The fitness score, a lower value indicates better fitness.
